quest.title: Problem Conversion: The Underpinning Factor
quest.description: Rafiq has learned some lessons from his previous tests...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: If we increase the strength here, we'll have to...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: If you go with this design, there won't be much of a difference from the one before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still working on your ship design?

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Ah, it's the Traveler. Yes, Qishan and I have discussed some... key aspects of the design since our last trial.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: We had a... full exchange of opinions, and are trying to work out a new design.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But we still had some divergence regarding the use of materials.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But I followed Qishan's advice this time! I bought a bunch of solid materials. Cost me a fortune, too!

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: As you can see, Traveler, I can't move all these alone. Qishan isn't strong enough either, so could you...

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: I knew I could count on you! Let's get rolling.

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: Qishan hand-picked the materials herself. I believe that things will work out this time.

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: I've got bigger rewards for you this time as well. Thanks for your help.

talks.objective: Fetch the materials for building the ship

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Talking Rafiq into spending more Mora is actually harder than getting my boss to give me a raise.

talks.objective: Fetch the materials for building the ship
Return and report the situation to Rafiq

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: So? Have you finished moving the materials over?

talks.objective: Return and report the situation to Rafiq

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Aye, these materials should do. Please take your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: The materials that Qishan chose are really light... Are they really reliable?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Trust me. They'll do better than the ones you picked before.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Well, guess it's your turn to prepare life jackets for me...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Oh, have some trust in me... These will suffice.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Well, now my budget has really been spent out...
